description:
THEN: return limited partner records (name, slug, LP type, HQ country and city, geographic focus, website, emerging-manager backing, verified flag, and michael_network: {has_warm_path: boolean, matches?}) filtered by country, LP type and emerging-manager backing, at most 25 per call. has_warm_path is free and unconditional on every caller; when true, a Pro/Enterprise caller also gets the matched contact's name in matches, everyone else gets a teaser (no content, just confirmation it exists) pointing at request_warm_intro or the LP's own page -- credits, not a subscription, unlock it. This is Michael Schneider's own personal network, not a data-matching feature; no data source is ever named. Set backs_emerging_managers=true to see only LPs that have already backed a first or second fund — for a first-time manager that is usually the only filter that matters. Billed exactly like get_fund, per caller: no key, a handful of free calls a day; a free/Starter/Pro key draws from a shared monthly "profile pull" allowance with get_fund (Free 20/mo, Starter 200/mo, Pro unlimited); an agent key is billed per LP returned at the same per-row price as search_funds, with no monthly cap since every row is paid. Use check_lp_coverage first — it is free and unmetered, and tells you whether the dataset covers your geography and LP type before you call this. website is null when no website is on record; it is never omitted.
Cost: free with no key (10 keyless calls per day); a free/Starter/Pro key draws from the same monthly "profile pull" allowance as get_fund (Free 20/mo, Starter 200/mo, Pro unlimited); an agent key is billed per LP returned at the same per-row price as search_funds (1 credit, EUR 0.01 each), with no monthly cap since every row is paid.

backs_emerging_managers.description: true returns only LPs that have backed an emerging manager; false returns only those that have not. Omit for both. Not available on check_lp_coverage, which reports the figure as a breakdown instead.

country.description: Headquarters country of the LP, spelled out in full (e.g. 'Germany'). Two-letter ISO codes are accepted too.

limit.description: Records to return, 1-25. A value above 25 is rejected, not clamped.

lp_type.description: LP type. Must be one of the listed values; common spellings such as 'family office' or 'pension' are accepted and normalised.

name: search_lps
title: Search LP records
